title: Israel assassinating Nazi rocket scientists in Egypt via the Gehlen organization
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Israel assassinating Nazi rocket scientists in Egypt via the Gehlen organization, about post-WWII at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Israel was assassinating Nazi scotet scientists in Egypt that were developing you know rocket weapons for the Egyptian military but leveraging you know the Gellen organization I believe

plain: A man presented as a Pentagon whistleblower, Matthew Brown, says on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2026 that after the Second World War Israel was assassinating Nazi scientists who were building rocket weapons for the Egyptian military. He says, though only that he believes it, that Israel did this by using the Gehlen organization, a spy network named after Reinhard Gehlen. He tells it to show how far states will go over scientists with dangerous knowledge.
